item.title: מבצע ישראלי בעזה הורג 4, אומרים גורמים פלסטינים
item.description: שר הביטחון של ישראל אמר כי המבצע הביא ללכידתו של בכיר חמאס. חמאס אמר כי ישראל שלחה פעילים חשאיים לתוך העיר עזה.

item.title: Netanyahu’s Israel Is Looking for a Fight in Every Direction
item.description: The Israeli leader, facing a tough re-election contest, may need a security crisis to rally voters behind him and hold on to his job.

item.title: In Egypt, Xi Challenges America’s Influence in the Middle East
item.description: China’s leader, Xi Jinping, is seeking to deepen ties with a longtime U.S. security partner and to project a larger role for Beijing in a region rocked by war.

item.title: Status of Iran’s Nuclear Program Is Unclear, U.N. Watchdog Says
item.description: As the war sputters on, an internal report from the International Atomic Energy Agency said Iran’s refusal to grant access to its inspectors was an urgent concern.

item.title: China or the U.S.? Two Meetings Offer Competing Showcases of Global Power.
item.description: As Xi Jinping gathered with the leaders of Russia and Iran, Europe challenged the Trump administration at the G20, offering a split-screen view of a changing world.

item.title: U.S. Sanctions on Iran Cut Off Students from Tests Needed for Study Abroad
item.description: The latest measures have forced the cancellation of English proficiency and graduate exams, isolating many Iranians most eager to foster ties with the world.

item.title: U.S. and Iran Survey the Damage After a Night of Intense Strikes
item.description: The American military said its barrage was retaliation against recent attacks on U.S. forces and marine traffic. Iranian officials said a wedding was hit and civilians killed.

item.title: Canada’s Carney Ties Resuming Trade Talks to Trump Administration Insults
item.description: Amid a trade war, Canada’s Liberals swept three special votes and new polling suggested strong support for Prime Minister Mark Carney and his retaliatory tariffs against the U.S.

item.title: A Factory in Rural Ireland Is at the Center of a Dispute Over Russia
item.description: Alumina processed at a refinery in County Limerick may be feeding Russia’s war in Ukraine, an investigation suggested. There is little agreement on what to do about it.

item.title: U.S.S. Abraham Lincoln to Dock in Thailand on Wednesday, Pattaya Mayor Says
item.description: The U.S.S. Abraham Lincoln became an emblem of the strains of the war on the U.S. military. Now its crew will have some rest.
